name: checkpoint
description: Save an A0 session checkpoint for the current session and task. Bounded write to the checkpoint store only; never durable knowledge.
authorityNotes: Uses only membrane_checkpoint_save, which writes an A0 session orientation checkpoint scoped to the caller's exact binding. The prompt grants NO authority above that single operation — no proposal, no feedback, no working-context close, no scratchpad write.

arguments.name: checkpointLabel
arguments.description: Short label the caller wants stored on the checkpoint.

arguments.name: summary
arguments.description: Free-form summary text the caller wants stored on the checkpoint (bounded by MAX_PROPOSAL_BYTES).

content.text: Save an A0 session checkpoint labeled "${checkpointLabel}" against repository=${repository}. Build a checkpoint object whose only fields are label="${checkpointLabel}" and summary="${summary}", then call membrane_checkpoint_save with that checkpoint and the caller's existing exact caller binding. Surface the typed lifecycleReceipt verbatim. This prompt writes only to the checkpoint store — do not call membrane_knowledge_propose, membrane_feedback, membrane_working_context(operation=close), or membrane_scratchpad.
